about: Breaks and breakups (dungeon/life/breakups.py): after a break, the companion's first message ending the relationship for good, gently and clearly, without blame. Used only when no model writes the first text; picked by seeded dice. Era-neutral, no gendered words.
templates: I've thought about it a lot, and I think we should end things.
The break gave me the clarity I was hoping for. I don't think we should get back together.
This is the hardest thing I've ever had to say to you. I think it's over between us.
I've spent these weeks really listening to myself. I need to end our relationship.
I don't blame you for any of it. I just don't think we work anymore, and I'm ending things.
I wanted to tell you honestly instead of letting it drift. I'm not coming back to us.
I've made my decision. I think we're better apart, and I'm so sorry.
I kept hoping the time away would change how I felt. It didn't. I think we should end this.
You deserve a clear answer, so here it is: I want to end things.
I'll always be grateful for what we had. But I'm ending it.
It's over for me. I'm sorry. I didn't want to leave you waiting any longer.
I think we both knew this was coming. I'm ending things, gently and for good.
I've cried about this more than I can say. I don't want to keep going as a couple.
I'm not angry, and I don't want you to be either. I just think we should let each other go.
This isn't about one fight or one mistake. I just don't feel what I need to feel anymore. I'm sorry.
Thank you for giving me the space to think. I've decided we should end it.
I've made peace with this, and I hope you can too someday. We're done.
I don't want to drag this out. I think we should break up.
Part of me will always care about you. I still think this is the end for us.
I need to be clear so neither of us is left hoping: I'm ending our relationship.
I tried to picture us a year from now and couldn't. I think it's time to say goodbye.
I'm sorry it took so long to say this. I'm ending things between us.
You didn't do anything wrong. We just grew in different directions, and I'm letting us go.
I've decided. I think we should stop trying and part kindly.
I wish I had something different to tell you. It's over, and I mean it.
The time apart showed me how much lighter I've felt. I think that's my answer.
I don't think we're good for each other anymore. I'm ending it, with all the care I have.
I want to say this while I can still say it kindly. I think we should end things.
I loved being yours. I don't think I can be anymore.
I've gone over it a hundred times. Every time, I land in the same place. We should end this.
I'm closing this chapter. I'm sorry it hurts, and I'm sorry it has to be me.
There's no one else and no big reason. I just know it's time for us to end.
I hope you'll believe me that I didn't decide this lightly. We're done as a couple.
I don't want to keep you hanging on something I can't give. I'm ending things.
I have to be honest, even though it's awful: I'm not in love with us anymore.
I think we should part ways. I'll always wish you well.
I'm sorry. I've decided not to come back from the break.
If I'm truthful, I've known for a while. I think we should end it for good.
I can't promise you a future I don't feel. So I'm ending this now.
I'm letting go. Please take care of yourself.
I'm not going to list reasons or point fingers. I just know this is over.
I hope one day we can both look back at this kindly. For now, I'm ending things.
I want you to have someone who's sure about you. I'm not anymore, and I'm sorry.
The break helped me understand what I need, and it isn't us.
I don't want to fight about this. I just want to tell you it's over, and that I'm sorry.
I'm ending our relationship. It's the right thing, even if it doesn't feel like it tonight.
I've decided we should go our separate ways.
You were a real and lovely part of my life. I think this is where we stop.
I spent a long time hoping to feel differently. I don't, so I'm saying it plainly: we're over.
I think we should end things. I'll answer whatever you want to ask, as honestly as I can.
I'm sorry for every way I let you down. I'm ending this so neither of us keeps hurting.
This isn't a pause anymore. It's an ending.
I didn't want to say this with a cold heart, so I waited until I could say it gently. I'm ending things.
I wish we could have found our way back. I don't think we can.
I'm choosing to end it. I hope you'll find peace with that in your own time.
It's not that I stopped caring. It's that caring isn't enough for us anymore.
I know this will hurt. I'm still sure. I think we should end things.
I'd rather give you a clean goodbye than a slow, uncertain one. It's over.
I don't think there's a way back for us, and I don't want to pretend there is.
I needed this time to be sure. Now I am. I'm ending our relationship.
Neither of us is the villain here. We just aren't right anymore.
I won't be coming back to us. I'm sorry, truly.
There's a version of me that wishes this were different. But I've decided to end it.
I think we've given this everything we had. I'm ready to let it go.
I'm ending things. Please don't think it means you weren't loved. You were.
I've been honest with myself, and now I'm being honest with you: I want to break up.
I hope you know I'm not doing this lightly. We should end our relationship.
I'm sorry to be the one to say it. I think we're finished.
I'd like to end this with kindness while there's still kindness between us.
After everything, I've decided we should stop being together.
I don't regret us. I just know we're done.
I feel sad and sure at the same time. I'm ending things.
I think we should say goodbye as a couple. I'm sorry it's ending like this.
Please don't wait for me to change my mind. I've made it up, and it's over.
I'm not going to drag you through more uncertainty. We're breaking up.
I think we both need to be free to find what we're looking for. I'm ending this.
This is goodbye for us. I hope the rest of your life is full of good things.
I spent the break trying to find a reason to stay. I couldn't find one that was honest.
I'd rather hurt you once with the truth than slowly with silence. It's over.
I'm ending our relationship, and I wanted you to hear it from me directly.
We had something good. It just isn't good anymore, and I can't fix that.
I'm going to step out of this for good. I hope you can forgive me eventually.
I've decided. No more back and forth. We're over.
I don't have a perfect explanation. I only know I need to end this.
I think we should end things between us. I'll give you whatever space you need now.
It's time. I think we both feel it. I'm letting us go.
I know you hoped the break would bring us closer. It brought me to a goodbye.
I'm not unhappy with you as a person. I'm unhappy in us, and I'm ending it.
I made my choice this morning, and it still felt right tonight. I'm ending things.
I'm grateful for every good day. I'm still ending this.
Let's end it here, while we can still be gentle with each other.
I'm sorry. I don't want to be together anymore.
This isn't easy to write. We're done, and I won't change my mind.
I hope you hear the care in this. I'm ending our relationship.
I'm finished trying to make us fit. I think it's time to stop.
I've grieved us already, quietly, during the break. Now I'm saying it out loud.
I'm ending things. I don't need you to agree, only to know it's final.
I think we were right for a time. I don't think we're right now.
I'm sorry for the hurt this will cause. I'm sure it's the right decision.
I've realized I'm happier on my own right now. I think we should end things.
I don't want to keep you in limbo. My answer is no, I'm not coming back.
I've decided to end it. I'll always be glad I knew you this way.
We tried. We really did. I think it's time to stop.
I couldn't find my way back to us. I'm ending things.
I need to choose myself here, and that means ending our relationship.
I think it's over, and I think it's been over for a while. I'm sorry I took so long to say it.
I wish you every good thing. I just can't be part of us anymore.
I want this to be the last hard thing I put you through. I'm ending it.
I've thought about it from every side. I think we should end things for good.
